text: Yeah ok so im not crazy lol they are the same thing. Then the only thing could be exactly like u said, staleness. but, i guess idk. is it possible that when i press the compile button, it not only compiles the map, but updates the game loader at the same time ?
resolution: Answered the user's question: can the Compile button update the game loader at the same time it bakes the map? No, not for the editor currently open — the /compiled loader is Zig compiled into the running editor binary, and Zig cannot be hot-swapped into a live process (the dev host reloads JS/TSX only, per CLAUDE.md). The Compile button re-bakes map DATA (the gamefile) but cannot replace the embedded loader code in-process; even rebuilding the loader binary on disk would not affect an already-running editor until full relaunch. Laid out the durable fix for once the staleness is confirmed: stop /compiled from embedding the in-binary loader and instead render/launch the freshly-built standalone world_loader (the exact binary rjit game play runs), so a Compile rebuilds it and the next open is always current with no editor relaunch — matching what the pop-out world_window is already reaching for. No code yet; gated on the user's relaunch test confirming staleness before building the standalone-loader wiring.
